_about: Operating parameters the rules fix. Each is quoted from the rule that sets it: 'quote' must appear verbatim in that rule's text in the Idea Record (checked by test_pack.py). 'sim' names the simulator setting that played the same role, where one exists.

parameters.name: Scaler cycle
parameters.value: 15 minutes
parameters.quote: Every 15 minutes

parameters.name: Scaler quality floor
parameters.value: pass chance 0.8
parameters.quote: clears the quality floor (0.8)

parameters.name: Expected cost of a task on a model
parameters.value: $/busy hour x hours / pass chance; cheapest wins
parameters.quote: Expected cost = $/busy hour × hours ÷ pass chance; the cheapest model wins

parameters.name: Drain target
parameters.value: queued work cleared within 15 minutes
parameters.quote: the target clears queued work within 15 minutes (not 2 h)
parameters.sim: Scaler.drain_h = 0.25 in the '15-min target' runs (default 2.0 reproduces r12)

parameters.name: Held demand
parameters.value: cards held behind prerequisites count as demand
parameters.quote: cards held behind prerequisites count as demand

parameters.name: Idle stop
parameters.value: 30 minutes idle beyond target
parameters.quote: stops instances idle 30 minutes beyond target

parameters.name: Cost band
parameters.value: 1.5x the cheapest qualified model
parameters.quote: within 1.5× the cheapest qualified model's (cost-band pull)

parameters.name: Cost-band wait
parameters.value: 1 hour
parameters.quote: unless the task has waited an hour

parameters.name: Instance limits
parameters.value: vendor rate limits (the model assumed 8 per model, 48 in all)
parameters.quote: within vendor rate limits

parameters.name: Instances and independence
parameters.value: instances of one model are one model
parameters.quote: Instances of one model are one model for independence

parameters.name: Hourly burn cap
parameters.value: 2x the trailing seven-day average $/hour
parameters.quote: at most 2× the trailing seven-day average ($ per hour)

parameters.name: Monthly ceiling
parameters.value: expected demand x cost per clean idea x 1.5
parameters.quote: expected demand × cost per clean idea × 1.5

parameters.name: High-impact floors
parameters.value: 0.8 for design, plan, plan red-team, security review, acceptance test, release; 0.6 other steps; 0.5 review
parameters.quote: at least 0.8 (other steps 0.6; review 0.5)

parameters.name: Hard-work reserve
parameters.value: 75% of full speed at home tier until reset
parameters.quote: 75% of full speed until reset

parameters.name: Promotion credit and debit
parameters.value: +1 per accepted card at home tier; -4 per markdown
parameters.quote: earns +1 promotion credit; each markdown costs −4

parameters.name: Promotion trial
parameters.value: 20 trial cards
parameters.quote: over 20 trial cards

parameters.name: Demotion
parameters.value: gross (over 2x the standard) after 10 cards; marginal (over 1.25x) after two consecutive failing batches of 20
parameters.quote: gross failure (over 2× the standard) after 10 cards; marginal failure (over 1.25×) only after two consecutive failing batches of 20

parameters.name: Promotion back-off
parameters.value: failed promotion doubles the credit needed, capped at 2x
parameters.quote: A failed promotion doubles the credit needed next time, capped at 2×

parameters.name: Fast track
parameters.value: new model needs 5 credit until its first failed promotion
parameters.quote: A **new model** needs only 5 credit to start trials until its first failed promotion

parameters.name: Late marks
parameters.value: counted twice
parameters.quote: counted twice

parameters.name: Time value in the Scaler's price
parameters.value: $0.5 per elapsed hour [baseline from trifecta.md; moves on live evidence]
parameters.quote: The time value starts at $0.5 an hour and moves on live evidence

parameters.name: Readiness hand-back
parameters.value: every institution checks incoming cards and hands back unfit ones before any build spend
parameters.quote: handed back at once to the institution that produced it, with the reason, before any build spend

parameters.name: Isa's sample of rule ratifications
parameters.value: 10% of ideas ratified inside the envelope [PROPOSED]
parameters.quote: Isa reviews a random 10% afterwards

parameters.name: Envelope widening
parameters.value: one step after 20 rule ratifications without an overturn; narrowed at once by an overturn [PROPOSED]
parameters.quote: 20 rule ratifications without an overturn widen it one step

parameters.name: Origination budget
parameters.value: at most 20% of the monthly ceiling [PROPOSED]
parameters.quote: Originated ideas may use at most 20% of the monthly ceiling
